title: Bot-only round acceleration — when all humans dead, surviving bots get aggression boost to finish the round
intent: User feedback 2026-05-29: 'надо ботов чуть агрессивнее сделать друг к другу когда все игроки кроме ботов померли, чтоб не затягивалась сильно игра'. Currently when all PlayerControlled bombers are dead but multiple bots remain alive, each bot continues to play its baseline personality. Coward + Coward = mutual avoidance → round drifts to 90s timeout → draw. This story: detect HUMANS_ALL_DEAD state + apply aggression boost to all surviving bots. Each bot's aggression += 0.25 (capped at 1.0), bomb-place rate +20%, dash usage threshold lowered. Plus TIME-SINCE-HUMANS-DEAD escalation: every 15 seconds further, additional +0.10 aggression. Round naturally resolves within ~20s of last human dying, avoiding draws.
rationale: Source: user playtest feedback 2026-05-29. Common scenario: 2+ Coward bots remain after player dies → mutual avoidance → 90s timeout draw → unsatisfying outcome. Cost: ~50 LOC change in bot-ai-system.ts + RoundState observation. Visible immediately in playtest after ship.
acceptanceHints: TARGET FILE: examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/bot-ai-system.ts — main bot decision loop.
DETECTION:
Per fixedUpdate (or every 0.5s for cheaper poll), query world: count PlayerControlled entities with BomberStats.alive=true.
When count = 0 AND there are 2+ alive bots remaining → enter HUMANS_DEAD mode for the rest of the round.
Store the timestamp when HUMANS_DEAD first triggered: `humansAllDeadAt: number` on the kaboom.game-state entity (or on RoundState).
AGGRESSION BOOST:
Once HUMANS_DEAD active, all bot AI decisions apply: effective_aggression = min(1.0, base_aggression + 0.25 + escalation_bonus).
escalation_bonus = min(0.30, floor((now - humansAllDeadAt) / 15s) × 0.10).
So at +0s: +0.25 base boost.
At +45s: +0.55 (effective Coward 0.25 → 0.80, Hunter 0.85 → 1.0 cap).
BEHAVIOURAL EFFECTS via boosted aggression:
Existing bot AI uses aggression for: bomb-place probability (higher = more bombs), flee weight (higher = less flee, more confront), chase-player weight (higher = closer pursuit).
When HUMANS_DEAD, the 'player' target becomes the OTHER bot — bots chase + bomb each other.
Existing chase-player logic generalises: select the nearest non-self bomber as 'target' instead of hardcoding PlayerControlled. Already general per S125 wall-aware chase pattern.
ADDITIONAL ACCELERATIONS:
bomb-place rate +20% multiplier on top of personality bias (existing rate × 1.2).
Dash usage threshold lowered: danger_score > 0.5 (was 0.7) so Coward dashes more readily.
Pickup magnet disabled (per S123) — bots no longer detour for pickups, focus on the kill.
PERSONALITY VISUAL:
Bots KEEP their visual personality (palette + accessory from S139). Don't change appearance.
Bot personality TAG remains the same in the HUD tally — but optionally show a small icon (⚡) next to bot rows when HUMANS_DEAD active. Player (spectator now) reads 'bots are fighting hard'.
EDGE CASES:
Only 1 bot remains alive (just killed the last opponent) → no boost needed; round resolves naturally next tick.
No bots, only humans → no detection, no boost.
Human dies + reconnects via 5s grace (per GDP-022-012) → HUMANS_DEAD detection re-evaluates per tick; if human comes back, boost CLEARS (humans-alive count > 0 again).
Sudden Death (S160 + S166) already active before HUMANS_DEAD triggers → both accelerators run in parallel. Walls shrink AND bots get aggressive. Round resolves very fast.
Round-start → HUMANS_DEAD = false (PlayerControlled spawned alive). Boost only triggers when humans actually die.
MULTIPLAYER (server-authoritative gameplay from S125):
Server's bot-ai runs the same detection + boost. No protocol changes — RoundState already in snapshot.
HUMANS_DEAD detected per server tick; reflects same outcome to all watching clients.

DETERMINISM: detection deterministic per (RoundState + alive flags); escalation deterministic per (now - humansAllDeadAt) with fixedUpdate dt. Bot-vs-bot regression test continues to resolve in budget (faster on average).
URL CONFIG:
`?botAccelerate=off` disables the boost entirely (returns to current passive bot-vs-bot behaviour). Useful for testing.
`?botAccelerationBoost=N` overrides 0.25 base boost.
TESTS:
Round with 1 human + 2 bots. Human dies → HUMANS_DEAD active → both bots' effective aggression increases by 0.25.
Round timeout test: 2 Coward bots only → round resolves within ~30s of HUMANS_DEAD trigger (not the full 90s timeout).
Escalation: at +30s after HUMANS_DEAD, effective_aggression = base + 0.25 + 0.20 = base + 0.45.
Cap: Hunter (base 0.85) + 0.25 boost = 1.10 → clamped to 1.0.
Human reconnects within 5s grace → HUMANS_DEAD clears, boost off.
?botAccelerate=off → no detection, classical behaviour.
VISUAL QA:
Solo round with 1 player + 3 bots (one of each personality from S141). Player dies → next 30s shows the 3 bots actively bombing each other to a clean resolution. No more standoff draws.
Connected mode 2 humans + 2 bots: one human dies → only 1 human + 2 bots → no boost yet (humans-alive > 0). Second human dies → HUMANS_DEAD triggers + bots accelerate.
HUD: bot rows in tally show ⚡ icon during HUMANS_DEAD acceleration window. Player can see 'bots are fighting'.
DOCS UPDATES (in this PR):
gameplay-systems.md §8 bot AI — add 'HUMANS_DEAD acceleration' as a state-based modifier.
gdd.md §Round structure — note that bot-only rounds resolve faster than the 90s timeout via this mechanism.
OUT OF SCOPE:
Per-personality boost variation (all bots get same +0.25 — uniform).
Aggression applied while humans alive (boost is HUMANS_DEAD only).
Cross-tab broadcast of boost state (multiplayer — server reflects via existing snapshot).
Visual emote animations on bots when aggressive ('charging' pose). Stays decision-only.
Player-toggle bot aggression mid-round. URL flag at session start only.
Compounding with Sudden Death (S160): both accelerators run independently — no special combined interaction.
